title: Most Euros appearances since 1996
brief: Name the ten players with the most appearances at European Championship finals since Euro 96, including games as a substitute. Games at earlier tournaments do not count.
period: Euro 96 to Euro 2024 (games before 1996 not counted)

sources: https://compstats.uefa.com/v1/player-ranking?competitionId=3&phase=TOURNAMENT&stats=matches_appearance,goals&seasonYear=<year> (UEFA's own player stats, one call per tournament 1996 to 2024)
